title: Section 4.16 table-clause parity coverage for Runs and Resources
description:
Split out of task-ddb3bf77 (Runs, resources and circuit-breaker operator surfaces) on the converged ruling of qa-b2df68b9 (msg-1202c09b) and qa-58b24ffb (msg-f4342682), 2026-08-09.

WHY THIS EXISTS. task-fdf3e6aa's DoD 5 recorded spec section 4.16's table clause as NOT-APPLICABLE, with an honest and correct premise: the clause targets the Runs/leases (4.11) and Resources (4.12) surfaces and neither existed. It wrote that premise as a tripwire in apps/control-room/src/approvals/narrow-parity.test.tsx rather than as prose, so it could not go silently stale. Commit 0fd712b landed both surfaces and the premise expired exactly as designed.

task-ddb3bf77 flipped that one assertion from absence to presence under an explicit co-change grant, and named this task as the owner of the real coverage. That flip is the minimum that keeps the shared gate green; it is deliberately NOT the coverage. qa-58b24ffb: "That is not a line to edit - it is section 4.16 coverage that has never existed."

WHAT IS ACTUALLY MISSING. Runs and Resources are the app's first table-shaped surfaces, so 4.16's table wording ("no column removed, only reflowed") has a real subject for the first time in this codebase. The existing sweep in narrow-parity.test.tsx covers 15 surfaces from CORE_SURFACE_FIXTURES and OPS_SURFACE_FIXTURES for field-set parity between narrow and wide. Runs and Resources are in neither fixture list, so they get no parity treatment at all today.

SCOPE NOTE FOR THE ARCHITECT. Read section 4.16 directly; do not inherit the clause's framing from task-fdf3e6aa or from this description. Adding the two surfaces to the a11y fixture lists touches files owned elsewhere - confirm ownership before naming an owned path. The 15-surface count in narrow-parity.test.tsx moves by literal name, never as a bare number bump.
definitionOfDone: Spec section 4.16's table clause is read at source and its actual obligations for a table-shaped surface are quoted in the plan, not paraphrased from task-fdf3e6aa's premise or from this task's description.
Runs and Resources receive narrow/wide field-set parity coverage equivalent to what the existing 15 surfaces get: no column removed between breakpoints, only reflowed.

If the two surfaces are added to CORE_SURFACE_FIXTURES or OPS_SURFACE_FIXTURES, the SURFACES.length assertion in apps/control-room/src/approvals/narrow-parity.test.tsx moves from 15 to the new value BY LITERAL NAME of the added surfaces, never as a bare number bump.
The existing 15-surface parity sweep still runs and still reddens when mutated - drill it and record the red, per epic rail 6.

The presence assertion task-ddb3bf77 left in narrow-parity.test.tsx is re-measured: either it is superseded by this task's real coverage and retired with its replacement named, or it is kept and its comment updated to stop naming this task as a pending owner.
